title: Red Hair Can Stay Hidden: 37% Carry The Gene In Scotland
hook: In Scotland, 37% carry the red-hair gene; far fewer visibly show it.
closing: Visible hair color does not reveal everything a family can pass on; inheritance is more complicated than appearances.
question: Does red hair skip generations in your family?

segments.say: Visible red hair appears in 1.5% of people worldwide in these data. It is much more common in Scotland.
The Scotland carrier estimate reaches 37%. A visible trait misses many people carrying a related gene.
The simplified gene-copy model assigns 100% expression to paired copies. It illustrates recessive inheritance, not every real-world hair-color outcome.
